evidence_quotes: Guangxi Jingui Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd. has selected Valmet to deliver two complete bleached chemi-thermomechanical pulping (BCTMP) lines to its mill in Qinzhou, China.
The order was included in Valmet’s orders received for the second quarter of 2026 and the start-up is scheduled in the second half of 2027.
data.reason: The article announces a major contract/order where Valmet was selected to deliver two BCTMP lines to Guangxi Jingui Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd.
